title: The release plan for Dynamics 365 Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28) is available now!!!
summary: The 2026 release wave 1 plan for Dynamics 365 Business Central (BC28) includes major features across copilot and agents, localization, development tools, e-commerce, financial management, governance, reporting, supply chain, and sustainability with rollout from April to September 2026.
key_points: General availability begins April 1, 2026, with regional deployments starting that date
Copilot enhancements include task pane management, autonomous agents, AI resource support, and content review capabilities
Development improvements focus on AL developer productivity through troubleshooting tools and coding agents
Supply chain features expand manufacturing usability, drop shipment handling, purchase quote management, and quality evaluation
Sustainability and localization updates support carbon footprint reporting and regulatory compliance across multiple countries
features: Manage tasks from all agents in dedicated task pane
Suggest gas emissions in sustainability journals with Copilot
Evaluate AL coding agents with BC-Bench

quotes.text: The 2026 release wave 1 plan covers all new functionalities that Microsoft plans to release to market from April 2026 to September 2026.
quotes.why_it_matters: Defines the exact timeframe and scope of features in this release cycle
